items.q: And we had Ben Webster, as I mentioned -- Israel Crosby was the first week or two

ctx.x: Definitely. And we had Ben Webster, as I mentioned -- Israel Crosby was the first week or two, he was changing all the time. Maybe he came from Fletcher Henderson's band in Chicago, a great black bassist. A great one.
Right, one of the truly great ones.
